question: Does native rules-mode sidebar enumeration reject PRES/BUS because Insignificant is set, and can a guarded AddCameo path persist?

segments.name: HouseClass::CanBuild
segments.abi: thiscall(House*, Type*, bool limitOnly, bool includeProduction), ret 0x0c

segments.name: ObjectTypeClass::FindFactory
segments.abi: thiscall(Type*, bool allowOccupied, bool requirePower, bool requireCanBuild, House*), ret 0x10

facts.fact: Outer Building update requires Owner==CurrentPlayer, +0x81==0, +0x41B!=0 and +0x660!=0, then selects the type array by BuildingType+0xEB8.

UnitType loop calls CanBuild(CurrentPlayer,type,false,true) at 0x44579D; nonzero EAX reaches AddCameo(UnitType=40,index) at 0x4457AE. There is no per-type Insignificant read or additional guard in this loop.

InfantryType loop calls CanBuild(CurrentPlayer,type,false,true) at 0x4457DE; nonzero EAX reaches AddCameo(InfantryType=16,index) at 0x4457EF. There is no per-type Insignificant read or additional guard in this loop.

House AI reads and clears House+0x1FC, enumerates House buildings at +0x6C/+0x78; active+0x90, positive Health+0x6C, current and queued Mission!=0x13, and owned-by-CurrentPlayer buildings reach virtual+0x4E0.

Existing cameo is retained when type virtual+0x94 FindFactory(true,false,false,CurrentPlayer) returns a factory and CanBuild(factory.Owner,type,false,true) returns nonzero. It does not read Insignificant or require a cameo image at this decision.

FindFactory checks building state, factory kind, mission, conditional CanBuild(limitOnly=true), type/factory Owner masks, naval compatibility and available building preference. No direct Insignificant read occurs.

rejected_hypotheses: The supported original Building::UpdateConstructionOptions enumerator directly excludes Insignificant infantry/units before or after CanBuild.
The supported original Strip::RecheckCameos directly prunes PRES/BUS solely because Insignificant is true.
implementation_implications: Do not describe a rules-mode repair as bypassing an observed native Insignificant filter; none was found in these exact native paths.

A successful full native CanBuild plus FindFactory admission is consistent with the original cameo retention path, but a supplement path still needs platform-specific sidebar layout and native-call identity handling.
The original sidebar uses CanBuild != 0, whereas strict production admission often uses > 0. Preserve that distinction when interpreting negative build-limit states.
Instrument actual level ownership/world, CanBuild result, factory result and cameo presence to localize the user platform case before claiming root cause.
limitations: Static disassembly of one supported disk image only; no user live platform process or Ares DLL bytes were inspected.
Direct memory operand inspection is not a proof about every transitive callee or every modded runtime path.
Ares may replace native sidebar storage and calls; fixed-inline cameo inventory is not validated for Ares by this evidence.
